QuestInfo.name: Good Luck Charm
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan said things had always been awkward between him and Mrs. Ming Ming's son, Jay. But he wanted to bridge that gap by giving Jay gifts. That's where Alpha and Beta came into the picture.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta gave Chief Stan a good luck charm to give to Jay, who was about to take an exam.

0.0: Have you met my son Jay? There's one book he's loved his whole life. He might be a little weak from all his studying, but he's the most brilliant person in Henesys. I'm sure he'll make a difference in Maple World when he grows up.
0.1: I'm sure you've heard that Jay is my wife's son from before our marriage, but I assure you I have always thought of him as my own son. Our relationship is still a little...awkward, though. Think you can help me with that?

yes.0: Jay has an important exam coming up. We say that #r#t4000959##k and #r#t4000960##k will bring you good luck for things like this. Couldn't hurt, right? I'd like #r5#k charms each to give Jay.

no.0: You are very inconsiderate. Aren't you?

1.0: Did you bring all the Charms?

yes.0: Thanks. This will really help me get closer to Jay. It would be even better if the Charm turned out to have powers.

default.0: Jay has an exam ahead of him. I want to give him #r5#k #r#t4000959##k and #r#t4000960##k charms...
